newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares gain in high, selective volume.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares gain in high, selective volume.

text.p: 1650 GMT - Shares gained overall with interest highly focused on a clutch of blue chips. The good foreign trend combined with some internal factors to drive some shares to fresh peaks.
*Volume -- 19.5 billion escudos overall -- was swollen by the fact that today saw investment funds closing their books for July, traders said.
*Inparsa appeared to have caught its breath after recent profit-taking and surged 7.4 percent to a new high of 3,690 escudos. Some analysts have set a short-term target of 4,000.
*Banco Sotto & Pinto Mayor was another record-setter ahead of the expected announcement of first half results on Thursday. The stock closed over five percent higher at 2,098 escudos.
*Telecel recovered from a mysterious slump late on Tuesday to close 8.1 percent higher at 14,700 escudos.
*Utility group EDP moved against the trend, dropping 1.4 percent to 3,190 escudos, while Portugal Telecom was also slightly weaker.

*Traders said that the recently-privatised utility appeared to find good support around 3,180 escudos. Amongst factors contributing to the fall was the fact that investors were already beginning to anticipate the coming onto the market of the first shares from the June sale which could be resold from September.
*The PSI-20 .PSI20 index ended 0.81 percent higher at 7,970.61.
